triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.note: The claim that both REVIEW-path gates skip a decision-backed withdrawn item is carried by the repro artifact (CHK-001) plus the two wirings (CHK-002 completeness, CHK-003 channel). CHK-001 adversarial is the negative control that rules out a gate which skips everything.

The anti-bypass half of the acceptance claim: an unbacked or unconfirmed withdrawal is still refused by both gates. Separated from AB-001 because a fix can satisfy the skip while failing this entirely, and that combination is the shipped-back-door outcome.

Delivery proof: B-8df9 CHK-004 carries zero waivers and its gates pass without them, while its unrelated CHK-002:happy:0 selector-pin waiver survives. Without this the story ends at the code compiles.

note: Bindings map the snapshot acceptanceClaim: skip only via the decision-backed helper (AB-001), unbacked withdrawals still refused (AB-002), waivers removed and B-8df9 green (AB-003).
